batch: E08 Secedit import, rollback and isolation source recheck

sources.title: secedit /import
relevantDocumentedBehavior: Applicable to Windows 11 and Windows Server 2025.
Requires a database and configuration template; supports overwrite, areas and log parameters.
Before importing a template to another computer, Microsoft directs operators to run /generaterollback on the destination database and validate the import file.
The securitypolicy area includes local and domain policy, including account policies and audit policies.

sources.title: secedit /configure
relevantDocumentedBehavior: Applies security settings stored in a database to the current system.
When /areas is omitted, all settings defined in the database are applied; securitypolicy covers local and domain policy/account policy scope.

sources.title: secedit /generaterollback
relevantDocumentedBehavior: Generates a rollback template for a specified configuration template against a database.

sourceBoundary: Microsoft documents command applicability, areas and rollback preparation. These pages do not demonstrate that applying an INF containing only PasswordComplexity leaves every other account/security field unchanged, nor do they establish exact restoration of a locally NotDefined value or effective behavior under managed policy.

currentCandidate.capability: Inert UTF-16LE one-setting template, supplied local/merged export parser and read-only /export observer.

nextAcceptance: On a confirmed disposable Windows 11 and Server 2025 VM, verify one-setting apply preserves all unrelated security-policy fields, test explicit Enabled/Disabled transitions, test rollback to local NotDefined, compare local and merged exports for management override behavior, and capture repeat/failure recovery. Do not register the candidate or declare target support from documentation or mocked tests alone.
